caption: The drawing depicts a seated female figure, rendered in shades of dark gray and black suggestive of a metallic statue. She is sitting on an ornate, high-backed chair colored in similar dark tones, with intricate patterns on the legs and backing. The woman's hair is styled in an updo, and she is wearing a draped, classical-style gown. Her body leans slightly forward as she writes with her right hand on a tablet resting on her lap, while her left hand holds the tablet steady. To the right of the chair, partially behind its legs, two closed books lie on the ground, both illustrated in the same dark hues as the chair and the woman. The background is a plain, light beige with no other objects or scenery present.
title: Statue Clock Decoration
